bugTimeline: Polish adoption commits a middle chapter and marks later chapter plot records stale.
The adoption action refreshes the workspace snapshot while holding its operation lock; snapshot publication schedules the existing stalePlotAutoSyncTask.

On action completion, releaseOperation schedules again if an earlier task exited while isPerforming was true. The surviving task calls the existing acceptStalePlot and holds the same workspace operation lock until its repository mutation and snapshot refresh finish.
The Batch loop formerly refreshed durable state and started the next chapter without awaiting that task, so startBlockerMessage could see unresolved plot state and/or workspace busy.
